consequence.statement: Pod restart events are now attached to the Kafka resource with the Pod in the related field; consumers filtering events by the Pod as the regarding object may see different results.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart now have the Kafka resource as regardingObject and the Pod in the related field.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Evidence does not say which environments consume these events (e.g. event filters or alerts); no static config predicate identifies exposure.
